## Yellow-headed Parrot (*Amazona oratrix*) SNP filtering and processing

-   Mexican towhees SNPfiltR vignette: <https://devonderaad.github.io/towhees.uces/uce.processing/towhee.filt.html>

-   SNPfiltR general package vignette: <https://github.com/DevonDeRaad/SNPfiltR>

### Load libraries

```{r load_libraries}
library(SNPfiltR)
library(vcfR)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(StAMPP)
library(adegenet)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
```

### Read in vcf

```{r read_in_vcf}
#| output: false
vcfR <- read.vcfR("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/amazona.oratrix.unfiltered.snps.vcf.gz")
```

### Make sample names match

```{r matching_sample_names}
vcfR

sample.info<-read.csv("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/clean_sample_info.csv")

#check vcf colnames
colnames(vcfR@gt)
sample.info$Desired_Sequence_Name

#fix sample names
colnames(vcfR@gt)<-gsub(".sorted", "", colnames(vcfR@gt))
colnames(vcfR@gt)

#make sure sampling file matches vcf
sample.info$Desired_Sequence_Name %in% colnames(vcfR@gt)[-1]
colnames(vcfR@gt)[-1] %in% sample.info$Desired_Sequence_Name

#reorder sampling file to match order of samples in vcf
sample.info<-sample.info[match(colnames(vcfR@gt)[-1], sample.info$Desired_Sequence_Name),]
sample.info$Desired_Sequence_Name == colnames(vcfR@gt)[-1]
```

### Retain only biallelic SNPs

```{r retain_biallelic_snps}
vcfR<-filter_biallelic(vcfR)
vcfR
```

### View allele balance

```{r allele_balance_filter}
vcfR<-filter_allele_balance(vcfR)
vcfR
```

### Set depth cutoffs

```{r depth_cutoffs}
#set min and max depth cutoffs
vcfR<-hard_filter(vcfR, depth = 3)
vcfR<-max_depth(vcfR, maxdepth = 100)
vcfR
```

### Remove invariant SNPs

```{r remove_invariant_snps}
#remove invariant SNPs
vcfR<-min_mac(vcfR, min.mac = 1)

vcfR

#vcfR::write.vcf(vcfR, "~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/2026/oratrix.vcfR.initial.filtering.vcf.gz")
```

### Create the popmap

```{r popmap}
#create popmap
popmap<-sample.info[sample.info$Desired_Sequence_Name %in% colnames(vcfR@gt)[-1],c(11,4)]
colnames(popmap)<-c("id","pop")
popmap$pop<-as.factor(popmap$pop)
popmap

#add in locality to sample name for PCA label
popmap$new_id <- paste(popmap$pop, popmap$id, sep = "_")
popmap$new_id <- str_replace_all(
  popmap$new_id,
  c(
    "_ao" = "",
    "Yoro_Hon"   = "Honduras",
    "Tabasco_MX" = "Tabasco",
    "Oaxaca_MX"  = "Oaxaca",
    "Chiapas_MX"  = "Chiapas",
    "Colima_MX"  = "Colima",
    "Socal_Parrot"  = "SCP",
    "Tamaulipas_MX"  = "Tamaulipas",
    "Veracruz_MX"  = "Veracruz",
    "San Luis Potosi_MX"  = "San_Luis_Potosi",
    "Nayarit_MX"  = "Nayarit",
    "Michoacan_MX"  = "Michoacan",
    "Guerrero_MX"  = "Guerrero"
  )
)

popmap

# write.csv(popmap, "~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/2026/popmap.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### View preliminary PCA

```{r missing_data_pca}
assess_missing_data_pca(vcfR = vcfR, popmap = popmap, thresholds = c(0.8, 0.9), clustering = FALSE)
```

```{r remove_outlier_missing_by_sample}
#outliers: Tamaulipas_MLZ_32244 appears to be contaminated above - removed
vcfR <- vcfR[, !colnames(vcfR@gt) %in% c("ao_MLZ_32244")]

#subset popmap to only include retained individuals
popmap<-popmap[popmap$id %in% colnames(vcfR@gt),]

#check missing data
miss<-missing_by_sample(vcfR)
vcfR.trim<-missing_by_sample(vcfR, cutoff = 0.80)
```

### Check how much data is missing by SNP, select a threshold, and save filtered VCF

```{r missing_by_snp}
#check missing by SNP
missing_by_snp(vcfR.trim)
vcfR.trim.80<-missing_by_snp(vcfR.trim, cutoff = 0.8)
vcfR.trim.80

#remove singletons
vcfR.trim.80<-min_mac(vcfR.trim.80, min.mac = 2)
vcfR.trim.80

# vcfR::write.vcf(vcfR.trim.80, "~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/amazona.oratrix.final.filtered.snps.vcf.gz")
```

```{r}
#load vcf and popmap
# vcfR.trim.80<-read.vcfR("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/amazona.oratrix.final.filtered.snps.vcf.gz")
# popmap<-read.csv("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/yhpa_popmap.csv")

#subset popmap to only include retained individuals
popmap<-popmap[popmap$id %in% colnames(vcfR.trim.80@gt),]

#read in sample data for subspecies column
yhpa_sample_data<-read.csv("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/table01_updated_yhpa_sample_sheet.csv")
dim(yhpa_sample_data)

yhpa_occs<-yhpa_sample_data[c(1:36),]

#remove honduras
yhpa_occs<-yhpa_occs[yhpa_occs$Subspecies != "hondurensis",]

#changing popmap column names to match
subspecies_popmap<-popmap
colnames(subspecies_popmap)<-c("sample_ID", "Country_State")

subspecies<-left_join(subspecies_popmap, yhpa_occs)

subspecies$Subspecies[is.na(subspecies$Subspecies)] <- "unknown"
```

### PCA

```{r}
#labeled pca
#convert each to genlight
gena<-vcfR2genlight(vcfR.trim.80)
#perform PCA
di.pca<-glPca(gena, nf=4)
#isolate PCA scores as a dataframe
di.pca.scores<-as.data.frame(di.pca$scores)
#reorder sampling file to match alphabetical order
popmap<-popmap %>% slice(order(factor(id, levels = rownames(di.pca.scores))))
#check that they all match
rownames(di.pca.scores) == popmap$id 
```

```{r}
#add in percent variance explained
var_frac <- di.pca$eig/sum(di.pca$eig)

# pca<-
ggplot(di.pca.scores, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill=subspecies$Subspecies), pch=21, size=4) +
   scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "auropalliata" = "#fff700", 
      "belizensis"  = "#ff99fd",
      # "hondurensis" = "#a76d00",
      "oratrix (east)" = "#ffab00",
      "oratrix (west)" = "#1E90FF",
      "tresmariae" = "#F75394",
      "unknown" = "#008B8B"
  )) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1, ", round(var_frac[1] * 100, 2), "% variance explained")) + 
  ylab(paste0("PC2, ", round(var_frac[2] * 100, 2), "% variance explained")) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(fill = "Subspecies")

# ggsave(pca,
#        filename="~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/figures/pca/yhpa_pca_vcfR_trim_80.svg",
#        device="svg",
#        dpi = 400, width = 8, height = 6)
```

### Formatted PCA - Figure 2B

```{r formatted_pca}
#ellipse
locality_nums<-read.csv("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/locality_nums.csv")
names(locality_nums)[1] <- "id"
popmap<-left_join(popmap, locality_nums)

di.pca.scores$id <- rownames(di.pca.scores)
ellipse_pca <- left_join(di.pca.scores, popmap)

pca.edit<-
ggplot(di.pca.scores, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill=subspecies$Subspecies), pch=21, size=7) +
   scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "auropalliata" = "#fff700", 
      "belizensis"  = "#ff99fd",
      "oratrix (east)" = "#ffab00",
      "oratrix (west)" = "#1E90FF",
      "tresmariae" = "#F75394",
      "unknown" = "#008B8B"
  ),
  labels = c(
      "auropalliata" = "*A. o. auropalliata*",
      "belizensis" = "*A. o. belizensis*",
      "oratrix (east)" = "*A. o. oratrix* (east)",
      "oratrix (west)" = "*A. o. oratrix* (west)",
      "tresmariae" = "*A. o. tresmariae*",
      "Unknown" = "unknown")
  ) +
   
stat_ellipse(
  data = ellipse_pca %>%
           filter(group == "12"),
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2),
  type = "norm",
  level = 0.98,
  linetype = "dashed",
  color = "black",
  size = 0.8
) +
  
  xlab(paste0("PC1, ", round(var_frac[1] * 100, 2), "% variance explained")) + 
  ylab(paste0("PC2, ", round(var_frac[2] * 100, 2), "% variance explained")) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.text = ggtext::element_markdown(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 13,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(l = 0.5)),
        legend.title.align = 0.5
    ) +
  labs(fill = "Taxonomy")

knitr::include_graphics("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/final_locator/cropped_figures/YHPA.pca.edit.svg")

# ggsave(pca.edit,
#        filename="~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/final_locator/cropped_figures/YHPA.pca.edit.svg",
#        device="svg",
#        dpi = 400, width = 8, height = 6)
```

### Linkage Thinning

```{r linkage_thinning}
##added revision
#linkage thinning
vcfR.trim.80.unlinked<-distance_thin(vcfR.trim.80, min.distance = 1000)
vcfR.trim.80.unlinked

# vcfR::write.vcf(vcfR.trim.80.unlinked, "~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/2026/snp_filtering/amazona.oratrix.80.unlinked.vcf.gz")
```

```{r}
#load vcf and popmap
# vcfR.trim.80.unlinked<-read.vcfR("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/2026/snp_filtering/amazona.oratrix.80.unlinked.vcf.gz")
# popmap<-read.csv("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/yhpa_popmap.csv")

#subset popmap to only include retained individuals
popmap.unlinked<-popmap[popmap$id %in% colnames(vcfR.trim.80.unlinked@gt),]
```

### Linkage Thinned PCA

```{r}
#labeled pca
#convert each to genlight
gena.unlinked<-vcfR2genlight(vcfR.trim.80.unlinked)
#perform PCA
di.pca.unlinked<-glPca(gena.unlinked, nf=4)
#isolate PCA scores as a dataframe
di.pca.unlinked.scores<-as.data.frame(di.pca.unlinked$scores)
#reorder sampling file to match alphabetical order
popmap<-popmap %>% slice(order(factor(id, levels = rownames(di.pca.unlinked.scores))))
#check that they all match
rownames(di.pca.unlinked.scores) == popmap.unlinked$id 

#add in percent variance explained
var_frac.unlinked <- di.pca$eig/sum(di.pca.unlinked$eig)

pca<-
ggplot(di.pca.unlinked.scores, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill=subspecies$Subspecies), pch=21, size=4) +
   scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "auropalliata" = "#fff700", 
      "belizensis"  = "#ff99fd",
      # "hondurensis" = "#a76d00",
      "oratrix (east)" = "#ffab00",
      "oratrix (west)" = "#1E90FF",
      "tresmariae" = "#F75394",
      "unknown" = "#008B8B"
  )) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1, ", round(var_frac[1] * 100, 2), "% variance explained")) + 
  ylab(paste0("PC2, ", round(var_frac[2] * 100, 2), "% variance explained")) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(fill = "Subspecies")

knitr::include_graphics("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/2026/snp_filtering/yhpa_pca_vcfR_trim_80_unlinked.png")
```

```{r splitstree_80}
#need to rename samples for splitstree
```

### Eastern MX subset

```{r}
#load vcf
# vcfR.trim.80<-read.vcfR("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/amazona.oratrix.final.filtered.snps.vcf.gz")

#samples being removed from original vcf after duplicates were removed
east.vcf<-vcfR.trim.80[, !colnames(vcfR.trim.80@gt) %in% c(
                                           "ao_LSUMZ_33050", #oaxaca
                                           "ao_LSUMZ_39731", #chiapas
                                           "ao_LSUMZ_43831", #colima
                                           "ao_LSUMZ_43832", #colima
                                           "ao_MLZ_50773", #guerrero
                                           "ao_MLZ_50774", #guerrero
                                           "ao_MLZ_50775", #guerrero
                                           "ao_UMMZ_130517", #michoacan
                                           "ao_UMMZ_95618", #tres marias
                                           "ao_UMMZ_95619" #tres marias
                                            )] 


#remove singletons
east.vcf<-min_mac(east.vcf, min.mac = 1)

east.vcf
```

```{r}
#subset popmap to only include retained individuals
popmap<-popmap[popmap$id %in% colnames(east.vcf@gt),]
popmap

subspecies_popmap<-subspecies_popmap[subspecies_popmap$sample_ID %in% colnames(east.vcf@gt),]
subspecies_popmap
```

```{r}
#| output: false
#load in sample data for filtered samples with numbered localities
locality_groups<-read.csv("~/Dropbox/08_yhpa_072025/locality_groups.csv")

popmap_locality<-left_join(subspecies_popmap, locality_groups)

names(popmap_locality) <- make.names(names(popmap_locality), unique = TRUE)

popmap_locality <- popmap_locality %>%
  mutate(
    Subspecies = ifelse(
      Subspecies == "" | is.na(Subspecies),
      "Unknown",
      Subspecies
    )
  )

popmap_locality
```

```{r}
#convert each to genlight
gena.east<-vcfR2genlight(east.vcf)
#perform PCA
di.pca.east<-glPca(gena.east, nf=4, parallel = TRUE, n.cores = 7)
#isolate PCA scores as a dataframe
di.pca.east.scores<-as.data.frame(di.pca.east$scores)
#reorder sampling file to match alphabetical order
popmap<-popmap %>% slice(order(factor(id, levels = rownames(di.pca.east.scores))))
#check that they all match
rownames(di.pca.east.scores) == popmap$id

#add in percent variance explained
var_frac <- di.pca.east$eig/sum(di.pca.east$eig)
```

### Eastern MX PCA - Figure 3C

```{r}
#pca
#for ellipse
ellipse <- cbind(di.pca.east.scores, popmap_locality)

# east.pca<-
ggplot(di.pca.east.scores, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill=popmap_locality$Subspecies), pch=21, size=7) +
   scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "belizensis"  = "#ff99fd",
      "oratrix (east)" = "#ffab00",
      "Unknown" = "#008B8B"
  ),
  labels = c("belizensis" = "*A. o. belizensis*",
      "oratrix (east)" = "*A. o. oratrix* (east)",
      "Unknown" = "unknown")
  ) +
  
stat_ellipse(
  data = subset(ellipse, grepl("^ao_SP_", sample_ID)) %>%
           mutate(PC1 = PC1 + 0.2, PC2 = PC2 + 0.3), #adjusting to have ellipse centered
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2),
  type = "norm",
  level = 0.945,
  linetype = "dashed",
  color = "black",
  size = 0.8
) +
  
stat_ellipse(
  data = ellipse %>%
           filter(group == "12"),
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2),
  type = "norm",
  level = 0.945,
  linetype = "dashed",
  color = "black",
  size = 0.8
) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(ellipse$group %in% c("12", "8"), NA, ellipse$group))) +
  
  xlab(paste0("PC1, ", round(var_frac[1] * 100, 2), "% variance explained")) + 
  ylab(paste0("PC2, ", round(var_frac[2] * 100, 2), "% variance explained")) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.text = ggtext::element_markdown(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 11,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(l = 0.5)),
        legend.title.align = 0.5
    ) +
  labs(fill = "Taxonomy")
```
